Golden pairs generated by the JVM emitter (`scripts/gen-parity-golden.clj`) for the nbb parity test
(`test/nbb/parity.cljs`). `<name>.kir.edn` is a KIR fixture exported by the JVM test namespace
(every public var of `kotoba.script-test` whose value is a KIR map), `<name>.mjs` the module the
JVM emitted for it, `<name>.opts.edn` (when present) the emit options taken from the var's
`^{:emit-opts …}` metadata; `f64.edn` pairs raw f64 bits with `Double.toString`.
Whole-number doubles inside a fixture (`-0.0`, `##Inf`) are written as
`#kotoba.parity/f64-bits "<hex>"` because the cljs EDN reader would read them as integers.
Regenerate after any emitter change: `clojure -M:golden`.

Last generation: 61 KIR goldens, 3595842 bytes of emitted ESM.
